text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Terra and Sonnet were voted out on day one after Terra's citizen claim came only under pressure, and the town fixed on Terra from the start. Sonnet, the officer, was killed on night two, which pushed suspicion onto Luna and Haiku. Haiku, the doctor, was then accused of Sonnet's death, and Sol had been marked and saved, which Haiku's claim revealed. The turning point came on day three, when Sol and Haiku both pressed Luna and her own vote on Sonnet became the lever. The town won by voting out Luna, the second killer, leaving Gemma and Sol as the citizens who survived with the officer and doctor.
